edition.notes: The official Latin Acta constituent occupies printed p. 596 in full and is subscribed by Gaetano Cardinal Cicognani, Prefect, and Enrico Dante, Secretary, at the offices of the Sacred Congregation of Rites on 26 July 1960.
edition.title: Decretum generale quo novus rubricarum Breviarii ac Missalis Romani codex promulgatur

work.author: Sacred Congregation of Rites
work.description: The general decree of the Sacred Congregation of Rites of 26 July 1960 promulgating the new code of rubrics approved the previous day by John XXIII, ordering its insertion in new editions of the Breviary and Missal, binding it from 1 January 1961, and adding the Variationes by which existing books could still be used.
work.title: Decretum generale quo novus rubricarum Breviarii ac Missalis Romani codex promulgatur
